why: Canon: drunk for sciatica (irq al-nasa). Bridge to a modern indication is interpretive: radicular pain is treated as neuropathic pain.
Canon, joints section: two dirhams for falls and blows and for muscle tears (dose attributed to al-Khuzi). Modern oral analgesics for musculoskeletal pain. Interpretive bridge.
